description: This file defines a custom ArrayAdapter called StableArrayAdapter, which assigns and maintains stable item IDs for a list of strings, ensuring consistent item identification across data set changes in an Android ListView.

classes.name: StableArrayAdapter
classes.description: A custom ArrayAdapter that provides stable IDs for list items, using a HashMap to associate string items with their positions.

methods.name: StableArrayAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter and maps each string object to its index for stable ID referencing.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the stable ID for the item at the specified position, or INVALID_ID if out of bounds.

methods.name: hasStableIds
methods.description: Indicates that this adapter maintains stable item IDs.
